observations: Photo 0 shows a large metal structure with two black cylindrical hoppers on top, each with a red funnel below, mounted on a black metal frame. Below the funnels are two blue machines, one with a visible motor. A rusted metal collection bin is at the front. A red engine is visible to the right.
Photo 1 shows a blue metal machine with a rectangular hopper on top, a cylindrical body with bolts and a central shaft, and a triangular base with two legs. It appears to be a press or grinder.
Photo 2 shows a tall black cylindrical metal tank with visible weld seams, standing on wooden blocks. A vertical pipe extends from the top. The tank appears to be made of sheet metal.
All photos show outdoor, unpaved ground with vegetation and other machinery in the background. The watermark 'DAMTECH CONSTRUCTION' is visible on all photos.
No brand or model names are visible on any of the machines.

Videos or photos showing the machines in operation, especially the debuncher and oil press.

response.reason: The seller claims a complete set of palm oil machines, but the photos do not show all components or confirm functionality. Without additional proof, the completeness, condition, and working state of the machines cannot be verified, which are critical for pricing. The identity is known by type, but the lack of brand/model and unverified claims require further evidence before pricing.
